about: Macfos Ltd operates Robu.in, a specialised e-commerce platform for electronic and mechanical parts. Portfolio covers robotic parts, drone parts, e-bike parts, IoT & wire less products, 3D printers & parts, DIY kits, development boards, Raspberry Pi products, sensors, motors, motor drivers, pumps, batteries & chargers, electronic modules, displays and other components.
